name: Coping
overview: Scripture teaches that coping with life's challenges is rooted in trusting God's presence, strength, and peace. Believers are encouraged to be courageous and unafraid because God is always with them, sustaining and upholding them in times of trouble. Jesus promises a peace unlike that of the world, enabling believers to face tribulation with confidence, knowing He has overcome the world. Furthermore, God works all things together for good for those who love Him and are called according to His purpose, providing a firm foundation for enduring hardships.
